description: This file defines application routing logic for a Flutter app, including route handling, argument classes for route parameters, and a method for generating routes based on route names.

classes.name: ContentDetailsArgs
classes.description: Encapsulates arguments required for content details route, primarily contentId.

classes.name: PlayerArgs
classes.description: Encapsulates arguments for the player route, including contentId and optional start position.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Handles route generation for the application, including handling missing arguments and route errors.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates routes based on RouteSettings, returning specific screens or an error route if arguments are missing or invalid.

methods.name: _errorRoute
methods.description: Returns a route displaying an error message when route generation fails.
